result.note: Tests Naxal movement history, the force behind Besra's July 2026 arrest, and the Home Ministry's July 2026 district classification.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Left Wing Extremist insurgency in India:
items: It began in 1967 with a peasant uprising in Naxalbari, a village in West Bengal.
The Communist Party of India (Maoist) was formed in 2004 through a merger of the two largest armed groups.
Violence peaked in 2004, the year the Communist Party of India (Maoist) was formed.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because violence peaked in 2010, when more than a thousand civilians and security personnel were killed. After the first wave was crushed, the movement regrouped across a forested belt of eastern and central India, drawing cadre largely from tribal communities.
questions.source: The violence peaked in 2010, when more than a thousand civilians and security personnel were killed.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, Misir Besra, the last absconding politburo member of the CPI (Maoist), was arrested by state police and the Commando Battalion for Resolute Action (CoBRA). CoBRA is a unit of which force?
questions.explain: CoBRA belongs to the Central Reserve Police Force. Besra was flushed out of the Saranda forest in West Singhbhum, Jharkhand, and carried a bounty of more than INR 10 million.
questions.source: State police and the Central Reserve Police Force's Commando Battalion for Resolute Action flushed him out of the Saranda forest in West Singhbhum in Jharkhand.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the status of Naxal-affected areas reported by the Home Ministry to the Rajya Sabha in July 2026:
items: No district is now classed as Naxal-affected, down from eight in December 2025.
Thirty-seven cleared districts are on a watch list the Centre calls Legacy and Thrust.
West Singhbhum is the only district still listed as a District of Concern.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three statements match the Home Ministry's reply. In the Legacy and Thrust districts security and development spending continues, and two-thirds of the security camps in cleared areas are staying.
questions.source: The Home Ministry told the Rajya Sabha on Wednesday that no district is now classed as Naxal-affected, down from eight in December 2025.
